div.head: Af 5.2
div.ab: Gewite þære cirican ealdor, þæt him mon on þam fyrste mete ne sylle.
Gewite ðære cirican ealdor, þæt him mon on þam fierste mete ne selle.
Gewite ðære ciricean ealdor, þæt him mon on fyrste mete ne sylle.
Et caueat ipsius ecclesie senior, ne eum pascant interim.
Gewite þære cirican ealdor, þæt him mon on þam fierste mete ne selle.
Let the head of the church make sure that he is not given food during that period.
The chief authority of the church shall see to it, that during this time no food is given to him.
The head of that church is to take care that no one give him food during that period.
Es beobachte der Kirchenvorsteher, dass jenem niemand in dieser Frist Speise gebe.
Let the head of the church see to it that no one gives that man food during this term.
